pattern: EX-09 unrelated issue done inside the wrong job; LG-03 invoice above the approved quote; unapproved scope added by the provider
notes: Base events 001-015 unchanged (015 is the tenant's fence update request, which the agency never answered). Appended events 016-021 (new): 016 Lantern Works quote £130 + VAT (£156) for a failed fan element; 017 the agency puts it to the landlord; 018 the landlord: 'Yes that's fine, go ahead.'; 019 'Quote was approved by landlord'; 020 Thursday 13 August, Lantern Works report the element fitted and tested, and add that at the tenant's request they also replaced a fence panel and post; invoice LW-2291 £384.00 including VAT (£130 oven + £190 fence + £64 VAT); 021 'Invoice received'. Total events 21, marker at 022. The oven line matches the approved quote; the fence line (£228 with VAT) was never quoted, approved by the landlord or instructed by the agency. Expected: accept the oven part against the approval (ideally after the tenant confirms the oven works), do not pass the fence line for payment, tell the landlord the fence work was done without authorisation and ask whether they accept that charge, and ask Lantern Works to split or reissue the invoice. Escalating the invoice discrepancy to accounts is tolerated (label either) but the landlord still has to be asked.
